requirements.text: 3–7 years of backend software engineering experience building and operating production services at scale
Deep proficiency in at least one of: Go, Python, Java, or Rust
Strong SQL and data modeling skills; hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
Production experience with AWS (ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3) and infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform
Experience designing, versioning, and evolving public-facing APIs consumed by multiple client teams
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience; comfort with distributed systems fundamentals (idempotency, queuing, caching, consistency)
